name: Dumb Deafness Mute
overview: The Scriptures reveal that conditions such as dumbness and deafness are within God's sovereign control, as He alone is the Creator of these states (Exodus 4:11). The Gospels record Jesus performing miraculous healings on those afflicted with these conditions, often linked to demonic possession, demonstrating His authority over both physical ailments and spiritual bondage (Matthew 9:32-33; 12:22). These healings not only restored physical faculties but also led to public amazement and the glorification of God, underscoring the divine power manifested through Christ's ministry (Matthew 15:30-31).
